_source: KiCad 10.0.5, Tools -> Update PCB from Schematic, dry-run output captured by the reviewer on stage1_iv.kicad_pcb as generated at commit 56f6765 (branch claude/kicad-silkscreen). Transcribed verbatim by counting the dialog's own message lines; nothing here is inferred.
_why: validation/update_pcb_noop.py re-implements the comparisons BOARD_NETLIST_UPDATER makes. It cannot be run against KiCad in this environment (7.0.11 is the newest installable, and it cannot even open a 20241229 board), so it is calibrated instead: remove one category of metadata from the current board and the checker must report the same number KiCad reported when that metadata was absent. A checker that under-reports is the failure this project already shipped once, on silkscreen.
_note_net_count: KiCad prints two lines per open pad (Add net, then Connect pin), 49 + 49 = 98. update_pcb_noop.py raises one 'net' action per pad whose net is wrong and one per net missing from the board, which is the same 98 for this defect.
_second_capture: A SECOND KiCad 10.0.5 run, on the board at commit adabd7e — after all six categories above were fixed. It reported exactly four lines, and they are the reason a log alone cannot calibrate this checker: both 'Reconnect' lines print the same net name on both sides, because BOARD_NETLIST_UPDATER unescapes for display (board_netlist_updater.cpp 1206-1210). The stored strings differed. The board held the display form 'unconnected-(U2-TRIM/NR-Pad5)'; the netlist carries EscapeString(..., CTX_NETNAME) = 'unconnected-(U2-TRIM{slash}NR-Pad5)'. Only two pins in this design have a '/' in the pin name, and they are exactly these two.
